_about: skqe dbq question families. Each family is one tested SQL template. Slots are filled into temp tables s_<slot>(id, txt) or bound as :<slot>; {opts} takes the chosen options' fragments, {defaults} the family's default filters unless an option drops them, {order} the ORDER BY. See QUERY_SPEC.md.

families.title: files named {file}

options.winner_only: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM files w WHERE w.path_id = p.path_id AND w.is_winner)

families.sql: SELECT p.path, p.kind, (SELECT count(*) FROM files f WHERE f.path_id = p.path_id) AS copies, (SELECT CASE WHEN w.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = w.archive_id) END FROM files w WHERE w.path_id = p.path_id AND w.is_winner) AS game_loads_from FROM paths p WHERE p.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_file) {opts} ORDER BY p.path

families.title: every copy of {file}
families.sql: SELECT p.path, CASE WHEN f.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose (' || r.name || ')' ELSE ap.path END AS location, CASE WHEN f.is_winner THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS winner, f.size, datetime(f.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified, a.load_rank AS bsa_rank FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id JOIN roots r ON r.root_id = f.root_id LEFT JOIN files af ON af.file_id = f.archive_id LEFT JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id LEFT JOIN archives a ON a.file_id = f.archive_id WHERE f.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_file) {opts} ORDER BY p.path, f.is_winner DESC, a.load_rank DESC

families.title: the copy of {file} the game loads
families.sql: SELECT p.path, CASE WHEN f.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose (' || r.name || ')' ELSE ap.path END AS loaded_from, f.size, datetime(f.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified, (SELECT count(*) - 1 FROM files o WHERE o.path_id = f.path_id) AS other_copies FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id JOIN roots r ON r.root_id = f.root_id LEFT JOIN files af ON af.file_id = f.archive_id LEFT JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE f.is_winner AND f.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_file) ORDER BY p.path
wordings: which copy of {file} does the game use
where does the game load {file} from

families.title: meshes using texture {texture}

options.in_folder: AND mp.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND mf.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

families.sql: SELECT mp.path AS mesh, t.slot, t.texture, t.status, CASE WHEN mf.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = mf.archive_id) END AS mesh_from FROM (SELECT x.file_id, x.slot, x.texture, CASE WHEN x.path_id IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM files w WHERE w.path_id = x.path_id AND w.is_winner) THEN 'ok' ELSE 'not loaded' END AS status FROM nif_textures x WHERE x.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_texture WHERE id IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT x.file_id, x.slot, x.texture, 'missing' FROM nif_textures x WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s_texture WHERE id IS NULL) AND x.path_id IS NULL AND x.texture IN (SELECT txt FROM s_texture WHERE id IS NULL)) t JOIN files mf ON mf.file_id = t.file_id JOIN paths mp ON mp.path_id = mf.path_id WHERE 1 {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY mesh, t.slot
wordings: which mesh has a texture named {texture}
which texture has a texture named {texture}

families.title: textures of mesh {mesh}
families.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT mp.path AS mesh, t.slot, t.block, t.texture, CASE WHEN t.path_id IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM files w WHERE w.path_id = t.path_id AND w.is_winner) THEN 'ok' ELSE 'not loaded' END AS status FROM nif_textures t JOIN files mf ON mf.file_id = t.file_id JOIN paths mp ON mp.path_id = mf.path_id WHERE mf.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_mesh) {defaults}) WHERE 1 {opts} ORDER BY mesh, slot

families.title: textures that meshes use but the game can't find

options.in_folder: AND mp.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND mf.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

families.sql: SELECT t.texture, CASE WHEN t.path_id IS NULL THEN 'missing' ELSE 'not loaded' END AS status, count(DISTINCT t.file_id) AS meshes, min(mp.path) AS example_mesh FROM nif_textures t JOIN files mf ON mf.file_id = t.file_id AND mf.is_winner JOIN paths mp ON mp.path_id = mf.path_id WHERE (t.texture LIKE '%.dds' OR t.texture LIKE '%.tga') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM files w WHERE w.path_id = t.path_id AND w.is_winner) {defaults} {opts} GROUP BY t.texture ORDER BY meshes DESC, t.texture
wordings: what textures do meshes need that i dont have

families.title: meshes with textures the game can't find

options.in_folder: AND mp.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND mf.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

families.sql: SELECT mp.path AS mesh, count(*) AS missing, group_concat(t.texture, '; ') AS textures FROM nif_textures t JOIN files mf ON mf.file_id = t.file_id AND mf.is_winner JOIN paths mp ON mp.path_id = mf.path_id WHERE (t.texture LIKE '%.dds' OR t.texture LIKE '%.tga') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM files w WHERE w.path_id = t.path_id AND w.is_winner) {defaults} {opts} GROUP BY mp.path ORDER BY mesh
wordings: meshes that reference textures that dont exist

families.title: details of mesh {mesh}
families.sql: SELECT p.path AS 'Mesh', CASE WHEN f.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = f.archive_id) END AS 'Loaded from', n.version AS 'NIF Ver', n.user_version AS 'User Ver', n.bs_version AS 'BS Ver', upper(n.game) AS 'Game', n.block_count AS 'Blocks', n.skin_strips AS 'Strips', n.shape_count AS 'Shapes', n.unread_shapes AS 'Unread shapes', n.vertex_count AS 'Vertices', n.triangle_count AS 'Triangles', (SELECT count(*) FROM nif_textures t WHERE t.file_id = f.file_id) AS 'Textures', (SELECT count(*) FROM nif_textures t WHERE t.file_id = f.file_id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM files w WHERE w.path_id = t.path_id AND w.is_winner)) AS 'Missing textures', f.size AS 'Size', datetime(f.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS 'Modified', f.error AS 'Error' FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id LEFT JOIN nif n ON n.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.is_winner AND f.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_mesh)

extra.title: Textures
extra.sql: SELECT 'slot ' || t.slot, t.texture || CASE WHEN t.path_id IS NULL THEN '  (missing)' WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM files w WHERE w.path_id = t.path_id AND w.is_winner) THEN '  (not loaded)' ELSE '' END FROM nif_textures t JOIN files f ON f.file_id = t.file_id WHERE f.is_winner AND f.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_mesh) ORDER BY t.idx

families.title: meshes with more than {number} triangles

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND f.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

families.sql: SELECT p.path AS mesh, n.triangle_count AS triangles, n.vertex_count AS vertices, n.shape_count AS shapes FROM nif n JOIN files f ON f.file_id = n.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE n.triangle_count > :number {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY n.triangle_count DESC

families.title: meshes with the most triangles

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND f.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

families.sql: SELECT p.path AS mesh, n.triangle_count AS triangles, n.vertex_count AS vertices, n.shape_count AS shapes FROM nif n JOIN files f ON f.file_id = n.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE n.triangle_count IS NOT NULL {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY n.triangle_count DESC
wordings: which meshes have the most polys

families.title: meshes for {game}

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND f.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

families.sql: SELECT p.path AS mesh, upper(n.game) AS game, n.version AS nif_ver, n.bs_version AS bs_ver FROM nif n JOIN files f ON f.file_id = n.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE n.game = :game {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY p.path

families.title: details of texture {texture}
families.sql: SELECT p.path AS 'Texture', CASE WHEN f.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = f.archive_id) END AS 'Loaded from', coalesce(d.format, 'TGA ' || t.bits || '-bit') AS 'Format', coalesce(d.width, t.width) || ' x ' || coalesce(d.height, t.height) AS 'Size (px)', d.mips AS 'Mipmaps', CASE d.is_srgb WHEN 1 THEN 'True' WHEN 0 THEN 'False' END AS 'sRGB', CASE coalesce(d.has_alpha, t.has_alpha) WHEN 1 THEN 'True' WHEN 0 THEN 'False' END AS 'Alpha', CASE d.is_cubemap WHEN 1 THEN 'True' WHEN 0 THEN 'False' END AS 'Cubemap', CASE d.is_dx10 WHEN 1 THEN 'True' WHEN 0 THEN 'False' END AS 'DX10 header', d.array_size AS 'Array size', f.size AS 'File size', datetime(f.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS 'Modified', (SELECT count(DISTINCT n.file_id) FROM nif_textures n WHERE n.path_id = f.path_id) AS 'Used by meshes', f.error AS 'Error' FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id LEFT JOIN dds d ON d.file_id = f.file_id LEFT JOIN tga t ON t.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.is_winner AND f.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_texture WHERE id IS NOT NULL)

families.title: textures {number} pixels or wider

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND f.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

families.sql: SELECT p.path AS texture, d.width, d.height, d.format, d.mips, f.size FROM dds d JOIN files f ON f.file_id = d.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE max(d.width, d.height) >= :number {defaults} {opts} {order}
families.order: ORDER BY max(d.width, d.height) DESC, p.path

families.title: textures in format {format}

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND f.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

families.sql: SELECT p.path AS texture, d.format, d.width, d.height, d.mips, f.size FROM dds d JOIN files f ON f.file_id = d.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE (d.format = :format OR (:format = '@uncompressed' AND d.format NOT LIKE 'BC%')) {defaults} {opts} {order}

families.title: textures without mipmaps

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND f.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

families.sql: SELECT p.path AS texture, d.width, d.height, d.format, f.size FROM dds d JOIN files f ON f.file_id = d.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE coalesce(d.mips, 0) <= 1 AND max(d.width, d.height) > 64 {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY max(d.width, d.height) DESC, p.path

families.title: details of archive {archive}
families.sql: SELECT p.path AS 'Archive', a.version AS 'BSA version', CASE a.version WHEN 103 THEN 'Oblivion' WHEN 104 THEN 'Skyrim LE / Fallout 3 / New Vegas' WHEN 105 THEN 'Skyrim SE' ELSE '' END AS 'Game', a.file_count AS 'Number of files', (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.dir) FROM files c JOIN paths x ON x.path_id = c.path_id WHERE c.archive_id = f.file_id) AS 'Number of folders', CASE WHEN a.compressed THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS 'Compressed', CASE WHEN a.compressed AND a.version = 105 THEN 'LZ4' WHEN a.compressed THEN 'zlib' ELSE 'None' END AS 'Compression type', (SELECT count(*) FROM files c WHERE c.archive_id = f.file_id AND c.packed_size IS NOT NULL AND c.packed_size <> c.size) AS 'Compressed files', (SELECT sum(c.size) FROM files c WHERE c.archive_id = f.file_id) AS 'Unpacked size', f.size AS 'File size', printf('0x%X', a.flags) AS 'Archive flags', printf('0x%X', a.file_flags) AS 'Content flags', (SELECT x.path || ' (' || c.size || ')' FROM files c JOIN paths x ON x.path_id = c.path_id WHERE c.archive_id = f.file_id ORDER BY c.size DESC LIMIT 1) AS 'Largest file', coalesce(a.loaded_by, 'not loaded') AS 'Loaded by', a.plugin AS 'Plugin', a.load_rank AS 'Load rank', (SELECT count(*) FROM files c WHERE c.archive_id = f.file_id AND c.is_winner) AS 'Files that win', datetime(f.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS 'Modified' FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id JOIN archives a ON a.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive)

extra.title: Contents
extra.sql: SELECT x.kind, count(*) FROM files c JOIN paths x ON x.path_id = c.path_id WHERE c.archive_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM files WHERE path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive)) GROUP BY x.kind ORDER BY count(*) DESC

families.title: files inside {archive}

options.in_folder: AND x.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'

families.sql: SELECT x.path, x.kind, c.size, c.packed_size, CASE WHEN c.is_winner THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS winner FROM files c JOIN paths x ON x.path_id = c.path_id WHERE c.archive_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM files WHERE path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive)) {opts} {order}

families.title: archives and how they load
families.sql: SELECT a.load_rank AS rank, p.path AS archive, coalesce(a.loaded_by, 'not loaded') AS loaded_by, a.plugin, a.version, a.file_count AS files, f.size, (SELECT count(*) FROM files c WHERE c.archive_id = f.file_id AND c.is_winner) AS files_that_win FROM archives a JOIN files f ON f.file_id = a.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE f.in_data {opts} {order}
families.order: ORDER BY a.load_rank IS NULL, a.load_rank, p.path
wordings: which archives does the game load
in what order do bsas load

families.title: loose files that override archive copies

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND b.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

by_type.sql: SELECT p.kind, count(DISTINCT p.path_id) AS files FROM files l JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = l.path_id JOIN files b ON b.path_id = l.path_id AND b.archive_id IS NOT NULL JOIN archives a ON a.file_id = b.archive_id AND a.load_rank IS NOT NULL WHERE l.archive_id IS NULL AND l.is_winner {opts} GROUP BY p.kind ORDER BY files DESC

families.sql: SELECT p.path, ap.path AS overrides_archive, l.size AS loose_size, b.size AS archive_size FROM files l JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = l.path_id JOIN files b ON b.path_id = l.path_id AND b.archive_id IS NOT NULL JOIN archives a ON a.file_id = b.archive_id AND a.load_rank IS NOT NULL JOIN files af ON af.file_id = b.archive_id JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE l.archive_id IS NULL AND l.is_winner {opts} ORDER BY p.path
wordings: what loose files win over bsas

families.title: files with more than one copy

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'

by_type.sql: SELECT p.kind, count(*) AS paths FROM paths p WHERE p.path_id IN (SELECT path_id FROM files WHERE in_data GROUP BY path_id HAVING count(*) > 1) {opts} GROUP BY p.kind ORDER BY paths DESC

families.sql: SELECT p.path, p.kind, count(*) AS copies, (SELECT CASE WHEN w.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = w.archive_id) END FROM files w WHERE w.path_id = p.path_id AND w.is_winner) AS winner FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE f.in_data {opts} GROUP BY p.path_id HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY p.path
wordings: files with more than one copy

families.title: largest {filekind} files

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND f.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

families.sql: SELECT p.path, p.kind, f.size, CASE WHEN f.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = f.archive_id) END AS location FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s_filekind) OR p.kind IN (SELECT txt FROM s_filekind)) AND p.kind <> 'archive' {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY f.size DESC

families.title: files in folder {folder}

by_type.sql: SELECT p.kind, count(*) AS files, sum(f.size) AS size FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%' {defaults} {opts} GROUP BY p.kind ORDER BY files DESC

families.sql: SELECT p.path, p.kind, f.size, CASE WHEN f.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = f.archive_id) END AS location FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s_filekind) OR p.kind IN (SELECT txt FROM s_filekind)) {defaults} {opts} {order}

families.title: files by kind

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'
options.in_archive: AND f.archive_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_archive_files)

families.sql: SELECT p.kind, count(*) AS files, sum(f.size) AS size FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE 1 {defaults} {opts} GROUP BY p.kind ORDER BY files DESC
wordings: how many files of each kind
what kinds of files do i have

families.title: files skqe couldn't read

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'

by_type.sql: SELECT f.error, count(*) AS files FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE f.error IS NOT NULL {opts} GROUP BY f.error ORDER BY files DESC

families.sql: SELECT p.path, f.error, CASE WHEN f.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = f.archive_id) END AS location FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE f.error IS NOT NULL {opts} ORDER BY p.path

families.title: details of sound {sound}
families.sql: SELECT p.path AS 'Sound', CASE WHEN f.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = f.archive_id) END AS 'Loaded from', a.container AS 'Container', a.codec AS 'Audio Fmt', a.sample_rate AS 'Sample Rate', a.channels AS 'Channels', a.bits_per_sample AS 'Bits', a.avg_bit_rate AS 'Bit rate', round(a.duration, 2) AS 'Duration (s)', CASE WHEN a.lip_size > 0 THEN 'True' WHEN a.container = 'fuz' THEN 'False' END AS 'Has Lip', a.lip_units AS 'Lip units', v.voice_type AS 'Voice type', v.plugin AS 'Voice plugin', f.size AS 'File size', f.error AS 'Error' FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id LEFT JOIN audio a ON a.file_id = f.file_id LEFT JOIN voice v ON v.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.is_winner AND f.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_sound)

families.title: voice files for voice type {text}

options.in_plugin: AND v.plugin IN (SELECT lower(txt) FROM s_plugin)

by_type.sql: SELECT v.plugin, count(*) AS files FROM voice v JOIN files f ON f.file_id = v.file_id WHERE v.voice_type = lower(:text) {defaults} {opts} GROUP BY v.plugin ORDER BY files DESC

families.sql: SELECT p.path, v.plugin, printf('%06X', v.object_id) AS info_id, v.response FROM voice v JOIN files f ON f.file_id = v.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE v.voice_type = lower(:text) {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY p.path

families.title: FaceGen files for plugin {plugin}
families.sql: SELECT p.path, g.kind, printf('%06X', g.object_id) AS form_id, f.size, CASE WHEN f.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = f.archive_id) END AS location FROM facegen g JOIN files f ON f.file_id = g.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE g.plugin IN (SELECT lower(txt) FROM s_plugin) {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY g.object_id, g.kind

families.title: details of animation {animation}
families.sql: SELECT p.path AS 'Animation', CASE WHEN f.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = f.archive_id) END AS 'Loaded from', h.content AS 'Content', h.game AS 'Anim Game', h.havok_version AS 'Havok version', h.pointer_size AS 'Pointer size', round(h.duration, 3) AS 'Duration (s)', h.frame_count AS 'Frames', h.transform_tracks AS 'Tracks', h.float_tracks AS 'Float tracks', h.annotation_count AS 'Annotations', h.event_count AS 'Events', h.variable_count AS 'Variables', h.clip_count AS 'Clips', h.animation_count AS 'Animations', f.size AS 'File size', f.error AS 'Error' FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id LEFT JOIN hkx h ON h.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.is_winner AND f.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_animation)

extra.title: Names
extra.sql: SELECT n.kind, n.name || CASE WHEN n.time IS NOT NULL THEN '  @' || round(n.time, 3) ELSE '' END FROM hkx_names n JOIN files f ON f.file_id = n.file_id WHERE f.is_winner AND f.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_animation) AND n.kind <> 'class' ORDER BY n.idx LIMIT 400

families.title: animation files with an event or annotation named {text}

options.in_folder: AND p.path LIKE (SELECT txt FROM s_folder) || '%'

families.sql: SELECT p.path, n.kind, n.name, round(n.time, 3) AS time FROM hkx_names n JOIN files f ON f.file_id = n.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE n.kind IN ('event', 'annotation', 'variable', 'animation', 'clip_animation', 'character_property') AND n.name LIKE '%' || :text || '%' {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY p.path, n.idx

families.title: details of script {script}
families.sql: SELECT p.path AS 'Script file', s.script_name AS 'Script', s.parent_script AS 'Extends', (SELECT count(*) FROM pex c WHERE lower(c.parent_script) = lower(s.script_name)) AS 'Scripts extending it', CASE WHEN f.archive_id IS NULL THEN 'loose' ELSE (SELECT ap.path FROM files af JOIN paths ap ON ap.path_id = af.path_id WHERE af.file_id = f.archive_id) END AS 'Loaded from', f.size AS 'File size', datetime(f.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS 'Modified', f.error AS 'Error' FROM files f JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id LEFT JOIN pex s ON s.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.is_winner AND f.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_script)
families.note: Functions, properties, states and flags aren't in the asset database yet (WHAM reads them from the file).

families.title: scripts that extend {script}
families.sql: SELECT s.script_name AS script, s.parent_script AS extends, p.path FROM pex s JOIN files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE lower(s.parent_script) IN (SELECT lower(txt) FROM s_script) {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY s.script_name

families.title: morphs in {tri}
families.sql: SELECT p.path, m.kind, m.name FROM tri_morphs m JOIN files f ON f.file_id = m.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE f.is_winner AND f.path_id IN (SELECT id FROM s_tri) {opts} ORDER BY p.path, m.idx

families.title: TRI files with a morph named {text}
families.sql: SELECT p.path, m.kind, m.name FROM tri_morphs m JOIN files f ON f.file_id = m.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE m.name LIKE '%' || :text || '%' {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY p.path, m.idx

families.title: details of plugin {plugin}
families.sql: SELECT p.name AS 'Plugin', coalesce(p.load_order, 'not active') AS 'Load order', CASE WHEN p.load_order IS NULL THEN '' WHEN p.is_light THEN printf('FE %03X', p.mod_index) ELSE printf('%02X', p.mod_index) END AS 'Mod index', printf('%.2f', p.hedr_version) AS 'Header version', t.form_version AS 'Form version', pf.master_forms AS 'Master Form Count', p.num_records AS 'Record count', printf('0x%X', p.header_flags) || ' ' || trim(CASE WHEN p.is_master THEN ' ESM' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN p.is_light THEN ' ESL' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN p.is_localized THEN ' Localized' ELSE '' END) AS 'Flags', CASE WHEN p.is_light THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS 'Light', pf.eslable AS 'ESLable', CASE WHEN pf.esl_needs_1130 THEN 'needs game 1.6.1130 or newer' ELSE '' END AS 'ESLable note', p.author AS 'Author - CNAM', p.description AS 'Description - SNAM', (SELECT group_concat('[' || m.idx || '] ' || x.name, char(10)) FROM (SELECT * FROM plugin_masters WHERE plugin_no = p.plugin_no ORDER BY idx) m JOIN plugins x ON x.plugin_no = m.master_no) AS 'Masters', (SELECT count(*) FROM plugin_masters WHERE plugin_no = p.plugin_no) AS '#Masters', coalesce((SELECT group_concat(x.name, char(10)) FROM plugin_masters m JOIN plugins x ON x.plugin_no = m.master_no WHERE m.plugin_no = p.plugin_no AND x.load_order IS NULL AND x.file_exists), 'None') AS 'Deactivated masters', coalesce((SELECT group_concat(x.name, char(10)) FROM plugin_masters m JOIN plugins x ON x.plugin_no = m.master_no WHERE m.plugin_no = p.plugin_no AND NOT x.file_exists), 'None') AS 'Missing masters', CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM plugin_masters WHERE plugin_no = p.plugin_no) THEN '' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM plugin_masters m JOIN plugins x ON x.plugin_no = m.master_no WHERE m.plugin_no = p.plugin_no AND NOT x.file_exists) THEN 'Missing' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM plugin_masters m JOIN plugins x ON x.plugin_no = m.master_no WHERE m.plugin_no = p.plugin_no AND x.load_order IS NULL) THEN 'Not active' ELSE 'All active' END AS 'MasterStatus', (SELECT count(*) FROM plugin_masters m WHERE m.master_no = p.plugin_no) AS '#Dependents', pf.deleted_refs AS 'Deleted references', pf.deleted_navm AS 'Deleted Navmeshes', coalesce(pf.itm, 'not built (skqe db add itm)') AS 'ITM records', CASE WHEN pf.deleted_refs > 0 OR pf.itm > 0 THEN 'True' WHEN pf.itm IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'False' END AS 'Dirty', pf.invalid_refs AS 'Invalid references', p.size AS 'Size', datetime(p.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS 'Modified', p.load_error AS 'Error' FROM plugins p LEFT JOIN plugin_facts pf USING (plugin_no) LEFT JOIN tes4 t ON t.plugin_no = p.plugin_no WHERE p.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin)

extra.title: Record types
extra.sql: SELECT type, count(*) || CASE WHEN sum(form_key >> 24 = plugin_no) < count(*) THEN '  (' || sum(form_key >> 24 = plugin_no) || ' new, ' || sum(form_key >> 24 <> plugin_no) || ' overrides)' ELSE '' END FROM forms WHERE plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) GROUP BY type ORDER BY count(*) DESC

extra.title: Deleted forms
extra.sql: SELECT type, count(*) FROM forms WHERE plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) AND flags & 32 GROUP BY type ORDER BY count(*) DESC

families.title: record types in {plugin}
families.sql: SELECT type, count(*) AS records, sum(form_key >> 24 = plugin_no) AS new, sum(form_key >> 24 <> plugin_no) AS overrides, sum(flags & 32 <> 0) AS deleted FROM forms WHERE plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) GROUP BY type ORDER BY records DESC
wordings: how many of each type in {plugin}

families.title: masters of {plugin}
families.sql: SELECT m.idx, x.name AS master, x.load_order, CASE WHEN NOT x.file_exists THEN 'Missing' WHEN x.load_order IS NULL THEN 'Not active' ELSE 'Active' END AS status FROM plugin_masters m JOIN plugins x ON x.plugin_no = m.master_no WHERE m.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) {opts} ORDER BY m.idx

families.title: plugins that have {plugin} as a master
families.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN d.load_order IS NOT NULL THEN 'A' ELSE '-' END AS active, d.name AS dependent, d.load_order FROM plugin_masters m JOIN plugins d ON d.plugin_no = m.plugin_no WHERE m.master_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) {opts} ORDER BY d.load_order IS NULL, d.load_order, d.name
wordings: which plugins use {plugin} as a master

families.title: active plugins with masters that are missing or not active
families.sql: SELECT p.load_order, p.name AS plugin, x.name AS master, CASE WHEN NOT x.file_exists THEN 'Missing' ELSE 'Not active' END AS status FROM plugin_masters m JOIN plugins p ON p.plugin_no = m.plugin_no JOIN plugins x ON x.plugin_no = m.master_no WHERE p.load_order IS NOT NULL AND x.load_order IS NULL {opts} ORDER BY p.load_order, m.idx
wordings: plugins whose masters are not active

families.title: the load order

inactive_only.sql: SELECT p.name AS plugin, CASE WHEN p.file_exists THEN 'not active' ELSE 'missing' END AS status, p.num_records AS records FROM plugins p WHERE p.load_order IS NULL {opts} ORDER BY p.name

families.sql: SELECT p.load_order, CASE WHEN p.is_light THEN printf('FE %03X', p.mod_index) ELSE printf('%02X', p.mod_index) END AS mod_index, p.name AS plugin, trim(CASE WHEN p.is_master THEN 'ESM ' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN p.is_light THEN 'ESL' ELSE '' END) AS flags, p.num_records AS records, (SELECT count(*) FROM plugin_masters WHERE plugin_no = p.plugin_no) AS masters FROM plugins p WHERE p.load_order IS NOT NULL {opts} {order}

families.title: light (ESL-flagged) plugins
families.sql: SELECT p.load_order, p.name AS plugin, CASE WHEN p.is_master THEN 'ESM+ESL' ELSE 'ESL' END AS flags, p.num_records AS records FROM plugins p WHERE p.is_light {opts} ORDER BY p.load_order IS NULL, p.load_order, p.name

families.title: plugins that could be flagged ESL
families.sql: SELECT p.load_order, p.name AS plugin, f.eslable, f.master_forms, CASE WHEN f.esl_needs_1130 THEN 'needs 1.6.1130+' ELSE '' END AS note FROM plugin_facts f JOIN plugins p USING (plugin_no) WHERE f.eslable IN ('True', 'Save in CK') AND NOT p.is_light {opts} ORDER BY p.load_order IS NULL, p.load_order

families.title: plugins with form version {number}
families.sql: SELECT p.load_order, p.name AS plugin, t.form_version, printf('%.2f', p.hedr_version) AS header_version FROM tes4 t JOIN plugins p ON p.plugin_no = t.plugin_no WHERE t.form_version = :number {opts} ORDER BY p.load_order IS NULL, p.load_order

families.title: plugins not saved by the SSE Creation Kit (form version below 44)
families.sql: SELECT p.load_order, p.name AS plugin, t.form_version, printf('%.2f', p.hedr_version) AS header_version FROM tes4 t JOIN plugins p ON p.plugin_no = t.plugin_no WHERE t.form_version < 44 {opts} ORDER BY p.load_order IS NULL, p.load_order

families.title: plugins with deleted references, deleted navmeshes or ITMs
families.sql: SELECT p.load_order, p.name AS plugin, f.deleted_refs, f.deleted_navm, coalesce(f.itm, 'not built') AS itm FROM plugin_facts f JOIN plugins p USING (plugin_no) WHERE (f.deleted_refs > 0 OR f.deleted_navm > 0 OR f.itm > 0) {opts} ORDER BY p.load_order IS NULL, p.load_order
families.note: ITM counts need the itm module (skqe db add itm); deleted references and navmeshes are always there.

families.title: plugins with the most records
families.sql: SELECT p.load_order, p.name AS plugin, p.num_records AS records, (SELECT count(*) FROM forms f WHERE f.plugin_no = p.plugin_no AND f.form_key >> 24 = p.plugin_no) AS new_forms, p.size FROM plugins p WHERE p.num_records IS NOT NULL {opts} ORDER BY p.num_records DESC

families.title: plugins whose author is {text}
families.sql: SELECT p.load_order, p.name AS plugin, p.author FROM plugins p WHERE p.author LIKE '%' || :text || '%' {opts} ORDER BY p.load_order IS NULL, p.load_order

families.title: records named {form}
families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', f.form_key & 16777215) AS form, f.type, f.edid, (SELECT n.name FROM form_names n WHERE n.form_key = f.form_key AND n.plugin_no = f.plugin_no AND n.name IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS name, r.name AS winner_in FROM forms f JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = f.form_key >> 24 JOIN plugins r ON r.plugin_no = f.plugin_no WHERE f.is_winner AND f.form_key IN (SELECT id FROM s_form) {opts} ORDER BY f.type, f.edid

families.title: every plugin that has a copy of {form}
families.sql: SELECT r.load_order, r.name AS plugin, CASE WHEN f.is_winner THEN 'Yes' ELSE '' END AS winner, CASE WHEN f.form_key >> 24 = f.plugin_no THEN 'original' ELSE 'override' END AS kind, f.edid, CASE WHEN f.flags & 32 THEN 'deleted' ELSE '' END AS deleted FROM forms f JOIN plugins r ON r.plugin_no = f.plugin_no WHERE f.form_key IN (SELECT id FROM s_form) {opts} ORDER BY r.load_order IS NULL, r.load_order

families.title: the plugin that wins for {form}
families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', f.form_key & 16777215) AS form, f.type, f.edid, r.name AS winning_plugin, r.load_order, (SELECT count(*) - 1 FROM forms c WHERE c.form_key = f.form_key) AS other_copies FROM forms f JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = f.form_key >> 24 JOIN plugins r ON r.plugin_no = f.plugin_no WHERE f.is_winner AND f.form_key IN (SELECT id FROM s_form)
wordings: what is the winning copy of {form}
which plugin has the final say on {form}
who has the last word on {form}

families.title: fields that differ between the copies of {form}
wordings: how do the copies of {form} differ

families.title: records that reference {form}

options.in_plugin: AND r.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin)

by_type.sql: SELECT f.type, count(DISTINCT r.form_key) AS records FROM form_refs r JOIN forms f ON f.form_key = r.form_key AND f.plugin_no = r.plugin_no WHERE r.ref_key IN (SELECT id FROM s_form) {defaults} {opts} GROUP BY f.type ORDER BY records DESC

families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', r.form_key & 16777215) AS form, f.type, f.edid, rp.path AS field, pl.name AS in_plugin FROM form_refs r JOIN forms f ON f.form_key = r.form_key AND f.plugin_no = r.plugin_no JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = r.form_key >> 24 JOIN plugins pl ON pl.plugin_no = r.plugin_no JOIN ref_paths rp ON rp.path_id = r.path_id WHERE r.ref_key IN (SELECT id FROM s_form) {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY f.type, f.edid

families.title: records {form} references
families.sql: SELECT rp.path AS field, t.name || ':' || printf('%06X', r.ref_key & 16777215) AS refers_to, (SELECT x.type FROM forms x WHERE x.form_key = r.ref_key AND x.is_winner) AS type, (SELECT x.edid FROM forms x WHERE x.form_key = r.ref_key AND x.is_winner) AS edid, pl.name AS in_plugin FROM form_refs r JOIN forms f ON f.form_key = r.form_key AND f.plugin_no = r.plugin_no JOIN plugins t ON t.plugin_no = r.ref_key >> 24 JOIN plugins pl ON pl.plugin_no = r.plugin_no JOIN ref_paths rp ON rp.path_id = r.path_id WHERE r.form_key IN (SELECT id FROM s_form) {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY rp.path

families.title: {type} records in {plugin}

by_type.sql: SELECT f.type, count(*) AS records FROM forms f WHERE f.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s_type) OR f.type IN (SELECT txt FROM s_type)) {opts} GROUP BY f.type ORDER BY records DESC

families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', f.form_key & 16777215) AS form, f.type, f.edid, (SELECT n.name FROM form_names n WHERE n.form_key = f.form_key AND n.plugin_no = f.plugin_no AND n.name IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS name, CASE WHEN f.form_key >> 24 = f.plugin_no THEN 'new' ELSE 'override' END AS kind, CASE WHEN f.is_winner THEN 'Yes' ELSE '' END AS winner FROM forms f JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = f.form_key >> 24 WHERE f.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s_type) OR f.type IN (SELECT txt FROM s_type)) {opts} ORDER BY f.type, f.edid

families.title: records {plugin} overrides

by_type.sql: SELECT f.type, count(*) AS records, sum(f.is_winner) AS winning FROM forms f WHERE f.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) AND f.form_key >> 24 <> f.plugin_no AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s_type) OR f.type IN (SELECT txt FROM s_type)) {opts} GROUP BY f.type ORDER BY records DESC

families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', f.form_key & 16777215) AS form, f.type, f.edid, CASE WHEN f.is_winner THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS wins, (SELECT r.name FROM forms w JOIN plugins r ON r.plugin_no = w.plugin_no WHERE w.form_key = f.form_key AND w.is_winner) AS winner FROM forms f JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = f.form_key >> 24 WHERE f.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) AND f.form_key >> 24 <> f.plugin_no AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s_type) OR f.type IN (SELECT txt FROM s_type)) {opts} ORDER BY f.type, f.edid

families.title: records both {plugin} and {plugin2} change

by_type.sql: SELECT a.type, count(*) AS records FROM forms a JOIN forms b ON b.form_key = a.form_key WHERE a.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) AND b.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin2) GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY records DESC

families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', a.form_key & 16777215) AS form, a.type, a.edid, (SELECT r.name FROM forms w JOIN plugins r ON r.plugin_no = w.plugin_no WHERE w.form_key = a.form_key AND w.is_winner) AS winner FROM forms a JOIN forms b ON b.form_key = a.form_key JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = a.form_key >> 24 WHERE a.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) AND b.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin2) {opts} ORDER BY a.type, a.edid
families.note: Both plugins have a copy of these records; use 'conflicts of <record>' to see which fields differ.

families.title: {sex} NPCs

options.in_plugin: AND f.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin)

by_type.sql: SELECT r.name AS plugin, count(*) AS npcs FROM forms f JOIN npc n ON n.form_key = f.form_key AND n.plugin_no = f.plugin_no JOIN plugins r ON r.plugin_no = f.plugin_no WHERE f.is_winner AND f.type = 'NPC_' AND (n.acbs_flags & 1) = CAST(:sex AS INTEGER) {opts} GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY npcs DESC

families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', f.form_key & 16777215) AS form, f.edid, (SELECT nm.name FROM form_names nm WHERE nm.form_key = f.form_key AND nm.plugin_no = f.plugin_no AND nm.name IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS name, r.name AS winner FROM forms f JOIN npc n ON n.form_key = f.form_key AND n.plugin_no = f.plugin_no JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = f.form_key >> 24 JOIN plugins r ON r.plugin_no = f.plugin_no WHERE f.is_winner AND f.type = 'NPC_' AND (n.acbs_flags & 1) = CAST(:sex AS INTEGER) {opts} ORDER BY f.edid
families.note: From each NPC's own Female flag (ACBS). An NPC whose traits come from a template takes its sex from the template, which this doesn't follow yet.

families.title: {type} records in the load order

options.in_plugin: AND f.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin)

by_type.sql: SELECT r.name AS plugin, count(*) AS records FROM forms f JOIN plugins r ON r.plugin_no = f.plugin_no WHERE f.is_winner AND f.type IN (SELECT txt FROM s_type) {opts} GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY records DESC

families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', f.form_key & 16777215) AS form, f.edid, (SELECT n.name FROM form_names n WHERE n.form_key = f.form_key AND n.plugin_no = f.plugin_no AND n.name IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS name, r.name AS winner FROM forms f JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = f.form_key >> 24 JOIN plugins r ON r.plugin_no = f.plugin_no WHERE f.is_winner AND f.type IN (SELECT txt FROM s_type) {opts} ORDER BY f.edid

families.title: deleted records in {plugin}

by_type.sql: SELECT f.type, count(*) AS records FROM forms f WHERE f.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) AND f.flags & 32 GROUP BY f.type ORDER BY records DESC

families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', f.form_key & 16777215) AS form, f.type, f.edid FROM forms f JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = f.form_key >> 24 WHERE f.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) AND f.flags & 32 {opts} ORDER BY f.type, f.form_key

families.title: identical-to-master records in {plugin}

requires.message: This database has no ITM data. Add it with: skqe db add itm --db <file.db>

families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', i.form_key & 16777215) AS form, i.type, (SELECT f.edid FROM forms f WHERE f.form_key = i.form_key AND f.plugin_no = i.plugin_no) AS edid FROM itm_forms i JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = i.form_key >> 24 WHERE i.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) {opts} ORDER BY i.type, i.form_key

families.title: references to records that don't exist

options.in_plugin: AND i.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin)

by_type.sql: SELECT p.name AS plugin, i.reason, count(*) AS refs FROM invalid_refs i JOIN plugins p ON p.plugin_no = i.plugin_no WHERE i.holder_referenced {opts} GROUP BY p.name, i.reason ORDER BY refs DESC

families.sql: SELECT p.name AS plugin, o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', i.form_key & 16777215) AS form, (SELECT f.edid FROM forms f WHERE f.form_key = i.form_key AND f.plugin_no = i.plugin_no) AS edid, rp.path AS field, t.name || ':' || printf('%06X', i.ref_key & 16777215) AS points_to, i.reason FROM invalid_refs i JOIN plugins p ON p.plugin_no = i.plugin_no JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = i.form_key >> 24 LEFT JOIN plugins t ON t.plugin_no = i.ref_key >> 24 JOIN ref_paths rp ON rp.path_id = i.path_id WHERE i.holder_referenced {opts} ORDER BY p.load_order, i.form_key
families.note: Only references held by records something else uses (the rest is noise).

families.title: records whose name or editor ID contains {text}

options.in_plugin: AND f.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin)

by_type.sql: SELECT f.type, count(DISTINCT f.form_key) AS records FROM fts_names_tri s JOIN form_names n ON n.id = s.rowid JOIN forms f ON f.form_key = n.form_key AND f.plugin_no = n.plugin_no WHERE fts_names_tri MATCH '"' || replace(:text, '"', '') || '"' AND f.is_winner {opts} GROUP BY f.type ORDER BY records DESC

families.sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', f.form_key & 16777215) AS form, f.type, n.edid, n.name, r.name AS in_plugin FROM fts_names_tri s JOIN form_names n ON n.id = s.rowid JOIN forms f ON f.form_key = n.form_key AND f.plugin_no = n.plugin_no JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = f.form_key >> 24 JOIN plugins r ON r.plugin_no = f.plugin_no WHERE fts_names_tri MATCH '"' || replace(:text, '"', '') || '"' {opts} ORDER BY f.type, n.edid

families.title: localized strings containing {text}

options.in_plugin: AND s.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin)

families.sql: SELECT p.name AS plugin, s.kind, printf('%08X', s.id) AS string_id, substr(s.text, 1, 200) AS text FROM strings s JOIN plugins p ON p.plugin_no = s.plugin_no WHERE s.text LIKE '%' || :text || '%' {opts} ORDER BY p.load_order, s.kind, s.id

families.title: conditions using the function {text}

defaults.winner: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forms f WHERE f.form_key = c.form_key AND f.plugin_no = c.plugin_no AND f.is_winner)

options.in_plugin: AND c.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin)

by_type.sql: SELECT c.type, count(*) AS conditions FROM conditions_v c WHERE c.function LIKE :text {defaults} {opts} GROUP BY c.type ORDER BY conditions DESC

families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', c.form_key & 16777215) AS form, c.type, (SELECT f.edid FROM forms f WHERE f.form_key = c.form_key AND f.plugin_no = c.plugin_no) AS edid, c.function, c.param1, c.param2, c.comp_value, p.name AS in_plugin FROM conditions_v c JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = c.form_key >> 24 JOIN plugins p ON p.plugin_no = c.plugin_no WHERE c.function LIKE :text {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY c.type, c.form_key
wordings: where is {text} used as a condition

families.title: records that use the file {file}

options.in_plugin: AND a.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin)

by_type.sql: SELECT f.type, count(DISTINCT a.form_key) AS records FROM asset_refs a JOIN forms f ON f.form_key = a.form_key AND f.plugin_no = a.plugin_no WHERE a.path IN (SELECT txt FROM s_file) {defaults} {opts} GROUP BY f.type ORDER BY records DESC

families.sql: SELECT o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', a.form_key & 16777215) AS form, f.type, f.edid, rp.path AS field, a.path AS file, p.name AS in_plugin FROM asset_refs a JOIN forms f ON f.form_key = a.form_key AND f.plugin_no = a.plugin_no JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = a.form_key >> 24 JOIN plugins p ON p.plugin_no = a.plugin_no JOIN ref_paths rp ON rp.path_id = a.path_id WHERE a.path IN (SELECT txt FROM s_file) {defaults} {opts} ORDER BY f.type, f.edid

families.title: files {plugin} names that the game can't find

by_type.sql: SELECT kind, count(*) AS files FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.path, CASE WHEN a.path LIKE 'meshes\%' THEN 'mesh' WHEN a.path LIKE 'textures\%' THEN 'texture' WHEN a.path LIKE 'sound\%' OR a.path LIKE 'music\%' THEN 'sound' WHEN a.path LIKE 'scripts\%' THEN 'script' ELSE 'other' END AS kind FROM asset_refs a JOIN forms f ON f.form_key = a.form_key AND f.plugin_no = a.plugin_no WHERE a.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) AND a.path LIKE '%.%' AND a.path NOT LIKE '%.egt' AND a.path NOT LIKE '%.egm' {defaults} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM paths x JOIN files w ON w.path_id = x.path_id AND w.is_winner WHERE x.path = a.path OR (a.path LIKE '%.wav' AND x.path IN (substr(a.path, 1, length(a.path) - 4) || '.xwm', substr(a.path, 1, length(a.path) - 4) || '.fuz')))) GROUP BY kind ORDER BY files DESC

families.sql: SELECT a.path AS file, o.name || ':' || printf('%06X', a.form_key & 16777215) AS form, f.type, f.edid, rp.path AS field FROM asset_refs a JOIN forms f ON f.form_key = a.form_key AND f.plugin_no = a.plugin_no JOIN plugins o ON o.plugin_no = a.form_key >> 24 JOIN ref_paths rp ON rp.path_id = a.path_id WHERE a.plugin_no IN (SELECT id FROM s_plugin) AND a.path LIKE '%.%' AND a.path NOT LIKE '%.egt' AND a.path NOT LIKE '%.egm' {defaults} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM paths x JOIN files w ON w.path_id = x.path_id AND w.is_winner WHERE x.path = a.path OR (a.path LIKE '%.wav' AND x.path IN (substr(a.path, 1, length(a.path) - 4) || '.xwm', substr(a.path, 1, length(a.path) - 4) || '.fuz'))) {opts} ORDER BY a.path
families.note: A .wav a record names counts as found when the .xwm or .fuz of the same name exists (that's what the game plays). LE FaceGen files (.egt, .egm) are left out: SSE never loads them.
wordings: which files does {plugin} need that are missing

families.title: plugins that name files the game can't find
families.sql: SELECT p.load_order, p.name AS plugin, count(DISTINCT a.path) AS missing_files, min(a.path) AS example FROM asset_refs a JOIN forms f ON f.form_key = a.form_key AND f.plugin_no = a.plugin_no AND f.is_winner JOIN plugins p ON p.plugin_no = a.plugin_no WHERE p.load_order IS NOT NULL AND a.path LIKE '%.%' AND a.path NOT LIKE '%.egt' AND a.path NOT LIKE '%.egm' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM paths x JOIN files w ON w.path_id = x.path_id AND w.is_winner WHERE x.path = a.path OR (a.path LIKE '%.wav' AND x.path IN (substr(a.path, 1, length(a.path) - 4) || '.xwm', substr(a.path, 1, length(a.path) - 4) || '.fuz'))) {opts} GROUP BY p.plugin_no ORDER BY missing_files DESC
wordings: which plugins point to files that dont exist

families.title: archives {plugin} loads
families.sql: SELECT p.path AS archive, a.load_rank, a.loaded_by, a.file_count AS files, f.size FROM archives a JOIN files f ON f.file_id = a.file_id JOIN paths p ON p.path_id = f.path_id WHERE lower(a.plugin) IN (SELECT lower(txt) FROM s_plugin) OR lower(p.name) IN (SELECT lower(replace(replace(replace(txt, '.esp', ''), '.esm', ''), '.esl', '')) || '.bsa' FROM s_plugin) OR lower(p.name) IN (SELECT lower(replace(replace(replace(txt, '.esp', ''), '.esm', ''), '.esl', '')) || ' - textures.bsa' FROM s_plugin) ORDER BY a.load_rank
